label: 3.2 cm Slant Pocket
description: A slant pocket has its opening cut on an angle, running diagonally from the waistband toward the side seam, with a standard ~3.2cm opening. The angle gives easy hand access and helps the pocket lie flat against the hip without gaping when sitting, making it the most common front-pocket style on tailored trousers. It reads as slightly more contemporary and sporty than a straight on-seam pocket.
